nodes.label: Turing Hall Main Entrance
nodes.tactile_cue: Double glass automatic sliding doors with tactile ground studs

nodes.label: Ground Floor Central Lobby
nodes.tactile_cue: Smooth terrazzo flooring with directional rubber tiles

nodes.label: Room 101 Lecture Hall
nodes.tactile_cue: Heavy wooden double doors with braille plaque on right side

nodes.label: Ground Floor Elevator
nodes.tactile_cue: Audible chime and raised braille call buttons on left door frame

nodes.label: Central Staircase Ground Floor
nodes.tactile_cue: Metal handrail on right side with high-contrast step edges

nodes.label: Central Staircase First Floor Landing
nodes.tactile_cue: Textured warning mat 1 meter before top step

nodes.label: First Floor East Corridor Junction
nodes.tactile_cue: Wall turns 90 degrees left with continuous baseboard guide

nodes.label: Room 204 Computer Science Lab
nodes.tactile_cue: Metal door with braille sign at 1.4 meters on latch side

nodes.label: Campus Science Library Entrance
nodes.tactile_cue: Carpeted flooring begins at glass turnstiles

edges.spoken_instruction: Walk straight ahead 12 meters through the main doors into the central lobby.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the tactile paving studs along the center corridor.

edges.spoken_instruction: Walk straight ahead 12 meters to exit through the main sliding doors.
edges.tactile_guidance: Tactile paving leads directly to the exit doors.

edges.spoken_instruction: Turn left and walk 15 meters down the west hall. Room 101 will be on your right.
edges.tactile_guidance: Keep left along the smooth wall until you reach the wooden double doors.

edges.spoken_instruction: Exit Room 101, turn right and walk 15 meters back to the central lobby.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the right wall back to the lobby opening.

edges.spoken_instruction: Walk forward and slightly right 8 meters to reach the ground floor elevator.
edges.tactile_guidance: Braille button panel is on the left wall of the elevator frame.

edges.spoken_instruction: Step out of the elevator and walk 8 meters straight ahead into the lobby.
edges.tactile_guidance: Terrazzo flooring opens into the lobby.

edges.spoken_instruction: Turn right and walk 10 meters to the central staircase.
edges.tactile_guidance: Handrail starts on your right.

edges.spoken_instruction: Step off the stairs, turn left and walk 10 meters into the lobby.
edges.tactile_guidance: Open terrazzo floor.

edges.spoken_instruction: Ascend 22 steps on the central staircase to the first floor landing.
edges.tactile_guidance: Hold the metal handrail on your right side. Steps have non-slip rubber nosing.
hazards: Stairs flight: 22 steps, intermediate landing at step 11

edges.spoken_instruction: Descend 22 steps on the central staircase to the ground floor.
edges.tactile_guidance: Hold the left handrail and watch step edges.

edges.spoken_instruction: Take the elevator up to Floor 1. Audible voice announces floor arrival.
edges.tactile_guidance: Press button marked with raised number 1 and star braille symbol.

edges.spoken_instruction: Take the elevator down to Ground Floor.
edges.tactile_guidance: Press button marked G.

edges.spoken_instruction: Exit the elevator, turn right and walk 10 meters to the east corridor junction.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the right wall guide rail.

edges.spoken_instruction: Walk 10 meters west along the corridor to the elevator entrance.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the left wall to the elevator call box.

edges.spoken_instruction: From the top of the stairs, walk 6 meters straight ahead to the east corridor junction.
edges.tactile_guidance: Transition from textured warning mat to smooth corridor flooring.

edges.spoken_instruction: Walk 6 meters west towards the central stairs landing.
edges.tactile_guidance: Stop when cane detects the rubber warning mat.

edges.spoken_instruction: Turn left down the north wing and walk 14 meters. Room 204 Computer Science Lab is on your right.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the right wall. The door has a raised braille plate next to the handle.

edges.spoken_instruction: Exit Room 204, turn left and walk 14 meters south back to the corridor junction.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the left wall to the main corridor opening.

edges.spoken_instruction: Continue straight east 22 meters down the corridor to the Science Library entrance.
edges.tactile_guidance: Follow the continuous right wall until floor texture changes from tile to carpet.
hazards: Recessed fire extinguisher cabinet on left wall at 10 meters

edges.spoken_instruction: Exit the library, walk west 22 meters back along the corridor to the junction.
edges.tactile_guidance: Carpet transitions back to smooth tile flooring.
